parameters.name: AttemptInterval
parameters.description: The retry interval on failure. Unit: seconds. Default value: 30.

parameters.name: Calendar
parameters.description: The custom calendar. This parameter is available for the cron time type.

parameters.name: ClassName
parameters.description:
The full path of the node interface class.

This field is required only when you select the Java node type. Specify the full path.

parameters.name: ConsumerSize
parameters.description: The advanced configuration for parallel grid nodes. The number of threads triggered for a single execution on a single machine. Default value: 5.

parameters.name: ContactInfo
parameters.description:
The node contact information.

><notice>This field is deprecated.</notice>

sub_parameters.name: Ding
sub_parameters.description: The webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot for the alert contact's DingTalk group. References: [DingTalk development documentation](https://open.dingtalk.com/document/org/application-types).

sub_parameters.name: UserMail
sub_parameters.description: The email address of the alert contact.

sub_parameters.name: UserName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the alert contact.

sub_parameters.name: UserPhone
sub_parameters.description: The mobile phone number of the alert recipient.

parameters.name: Content
parameters.description:
- If the node type is python, shell, or k8s, specify the corresponding script content.
- If the node type is golang, the content format example is {"jobName":"HelloWorld"}.

parameters.name: DataOffset
parameters.description: The time offset. Unit: seconds. This parameter is available for the cron time type.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The node description.

parameters.name: DispatcherSize
parameters.description: The advanced configuration for parallel grid nodes. The number of subtask dispatch threads. Default value: 5.

parameters.name: ExecuteMode
parameters.description:
The node execution mode. The following execution modes are supported:

- **Standalone**: standalone
- **Broadcast**: broadcast
- **Visual MapReduce**: parallel
- **MapReduce**: batch
- **Sharding**: sharding

parameters.name: FailEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the failure alert. Valid values:

- **true**: Enables the failure alert.
- **false**: Disables the failure alert.

parameters.name: FailTimes
parameters.description: The number of consecutive failures before an alert is triggered.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The application ID. You can obtain the application ID on the Application Management page in the console.

parameters.name: JobType
parameters.description:
The node type. The following node types are supported:

- java
- python
- shell
- go
- http
- xxljob
- dataworks
- k8s
- springschedule

parameters.name: MaxAttempt
parameters.description: The maximum number of retries on failure. Set this parameter based on your business requirements. Default value: 0.

parameters.name: MaxConcurrency
parameters.description: The maximum number of concurrently running instances. Default value: 1. This means that if the previous trigger has not finished running, the next trigger is not performed even if the scheduled time arrives.

parameters.name: MissWorkerEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the no-available-machine alert. Valid values:
- **true**: Enables the no-available-machine alert.
- **false**: Disables the no-available-machine alert.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The node name.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the console.

parameters.name: NamespaceSource
parameters.description: This parameter is required only for special third-party users.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The advanced configuration for parallel grid nodes. The number of subtasks pulled in a single request. Default value: 100.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: The user-defined parameters that can be obtained at runtime.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description:
The node priority. Valid values:
- **1**: low
- **5**: medium
- **10**: high
- **15**: very high

parameters.name: QueueSize
parameters.description: The advanced configuration for parallel grid nodes. The maximum cache size of the subtask queue. Default value: 10000.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID.

parameters.name: SendChannel
parameters.description:
The alert notification channel.

- Use the default channel of the application group: default.
- Specify a notification channel for the node: sms, mail, phone, or webhook.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The node status. Valid values: 0: disabled. 1: enabled. Default value: 1 (enabled).

parameters.name: SuccessNoticeEnable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the success notification.

parameters.name: TaskAttemptInterval
parameters.description: The advanced configuration for parallel grid nodes. The retry interval for a failed subtask. Default value: 0.

parameters.name: TaskMaxAttempt
parameters.description: The advanced configuration for parallel grid nodes. The number of retries for a failed subtask. Default value: 0.

parameters.name: TimeExpression
parameters.description:
The time expression. Set the time expression based on the selected time type.

- **cron**: Specify a standard cron expression. Online verification is supported.
- **api**: No time expression is required.
- **fixed_rate**: Specify a fixed frequency value in seconds. For example, 30 indicates that the node is triggered every 30 seconds.
- **second_delay**: Specify a fixed delay in seconds before each execution (1s to 60s).
- **one_time**: Specify a time in the format of yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss or a timestamp in milliseconds. For example, "2022-10-10 10:10:00".

parameters.name: TimeType
parameters.description:
The time type. The following time types are supported:

- **cron**: 1
- **fixed_rate**: 3
- **second_delay**: 4
- **one_time**: 5 
- **api**: 100
- **none**: -1

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: The timeout threshold. Unit: seconds. Default value: 7200.

parameters.name: TimeoutEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the timeout alert. Valid values:

- **true**: Enables the timeout alert.
- **false**: Disables the timeout alert.

parameters.name: TimeoutKillEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable timeout termination. Valid values:

- **true**: Enables timeout termination.
- **false**: Disables timeout termination.

parameters.name: Timezone
parameters.description: The time zone.

parameters.name: XAttrs
